name: Text Backdrop
description:
Shows text files on your desktop, behind your windows: cheat sheets, notes, or anything in plain text, ANSI colour or Markdown.

A conky-style text panel for GNOME on Wayland, where layer-shell desktop widgets can't run.

* Up to 4 sheets on each monitor, each with its own file, font, position, size and look
* Plain text, ANSI colour codes (16, 256 and 24-bit) and Markdown (headings, lists, code, tables)
* Redraws when a file changes, and picks up files on drives that mount after login
* Set font size, position, width, height, scale, background opacity and padding with sliders or by typing a number
* Sheets stay on the same screen when monitors are rearranged

Open the extension's settings to add sheets and choose their files.
